title: Page of Cups Tarot Card Meaning: Upright, Reversed & Love
description: Page of Cups upright: tenderness, imagination, a sweet surprise; reversed: shy feelings. Love, work, advice and Waite's 1911 text. Ask your question.
h1: Page of Cups Tarot Card Meaning
image_alt: Page of Cups, 1909 Rider–Waite–Smith card: a young page in a blue tunic with pink flowers holds out a gold cup with a fish peeking out, low waves behind him.
capsule: The Page of Cups brings tenderness, imagination and sweet surprises: a new feeling, a kind message or a sudden idea. Reversed, feelings stay shy or moody and creativity gets blocked. A gentle, hopeful card; what it takes is a little courage to show what you feel. Upright, the answer is yes, as delight greets the fish in the cup.

blocks.heading: What is on the Page of Cups card?
paragraphs: A young page stands by the sea and holds out a gold cup, from which a small fish looks back at him. Waite's page "contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him", and Waite calls the scene "the pictures of the mind taking form" (p. 204). The sea behind him has a reason in Waite too: the sign of the cup refers to water, which he says appears on every figure card of this suit (p. 198).

On the 1909 card he wears a blue hat with a long scarf and a blue tunic covered in pink flowers, with pink sleeves and yellow boots; his free hand rests on his hip. Low waves run behind him, and PAGE of CUPS is printed at the bottom. The figure fills the card, and the cup with its fish, held out to one side, is where the eye goes first.

blocks.heading: What did Waite write about the Page of Cups?
paragraphs: Waite's Page is a young person willing to help, studious and thoughtful, and the card also means news or a message (p. 204). Waite's reversed list moves from taste and attachment toward seduction and deception (p. 204). On Arcana Diary the reversed Page is read more gently, as shy or muddled feelings and blocked creativity; that is a modern reading, not Waite's.

blocks.heading: What does the Page of Cups mean upright?
paragraphs: Sensitivity and imagination lead here. The Page of Cups can point to a sweet surprise, a tender message, an invitation, or a feeling you are only beginning to notice. Ideas and intuitive nudges may arrive the way the fish does, out of nowhere, and the card asks you to meet them with curiosity rather than dismiss them as silly.

It often marks the start of something emotional or creative: a new friendship, a crush, a poem, a hobby picked up again. Tenderness is its strength, toward others and toward yourself. What small, unexpected thing has caught your attention lately?

blocks.heading: What does the Page of Cups mean reversed?
paragraphs: Reversed, the Page of Cups can point to shy feelings kept back for fear of looking foolish, or to moodiness that is hard to explain even to yourself. A creative block belongs here as well: the idea is there, but self-consciousness stops it at the door.

Sometimes the reversed card shows emotional immaturity, reacting from hurt pride or daydreaming instead of acting. Be gentle with it. A journal, a sketch or a short honest note can give these feelings a safe first outlet.

blocks.heading: What does the Page of Cups mean in love?
paragraphs: A tender note, a first date, a shy confession: few cards are as sweet in love. The Page of Cups describes the early, curious stage of feeling something, or a fresh, playful mood returning to a long relationship. On your own, it suggests openness to a gentle surprise.
Reversed, it can mean affection held back out of shyness, or mixed messages that come from not yet knowing what you feel. Try saying one simple, sincere thing and see how it lands.

blocks.heading: What does the Page of Cups mean for work and money?
paragraphs: Creative work suits this card best: design, writing, care, anything that uses imagination and empathy. Waite himself lists study, reflection and messages, "also these things directed to business" (p. 204). For money, the Page of Cups means small, pleasant news and creative ways to earn rather than large sums; reversed, it can mean spending on a mood or an impulse.

blocks.heading: What is the advice of the Page of Cups?
paragraphs: Notice one small, odd surprise today and let it make you smile. Then give a feeling or an idea a safe place to land: a line in your diary, a quick sketch, or a few words to someone you trust.

blocks.heading: Is the Page of Cups a yes or no card?
The Page of Cups as a person and as feelings
paragraphs: Young at heart at any age: that is the Page of Cups as a person, sensitive, dreamy, creative and kind, sometimes a little naive. The feelings it names are tender and new: sincere affection in its early stage, curiosity about where it might lead and a wish to express it with a sweet gesture or message. With the card reversed, affection stays unspoken, moods come suddenly, or an emotional immaturity makes the signals hard to read.

blocks.heading: The Page of Cups with other cards

pairs.text: A new feeling and its first tender message. Let it stay simple.
Imagination running ahead of reality. Enjoy the daydream, then pick one to act on.
Shy feelings in uncertain light; give them time before deciding what they mean.
Two curious messengers together: a creative idea with enough spark to begin.

blocks.heading: Page of Cups or Knight of Cups?
paragraphs: Waite's Knight of Cups is "graceful, but not warlike; riding quietly, wearing a winged helmet" (p. 202), and Waite's list for him opens with arrival and approach and includes invitation (p. 202). Today the Knight is read as romance and following the heart.
The difference is movement. The Page stands still and wonders at a feeling that has just surfaced; the Knight rides out and carries his cup toward someone as an offer.

blocks.heading: Questions to ask yourself about the Page of Cups
paragraphs: What small surprise has delighted me lately?
Which feeling am I shy to say out loud?
What idea would I try if nobody were watching?

faq.q: Is the Page of Cups a good or bad card?
faq.a: Good. It is a soft, hopeful card about new feelings, kind messages and playful ideas. Even reversed it is not a bad sign: it shows feelings or talents that need more courage and a safer place to come out.

faq.q: Does the Page of Cups mean someone likes me?
faq.a: It is the card of a crush, but it cannot confirm what a particular person feels. As feelings, it stands for early, tender affection and a wish to show it, often through a small gesture or message; that is why it comes up so often in love questions. What it can tell you best is what you feel and would like to say.

faq.q: Is the Page of Cups always a young man?
faq.a: No. Waite describes a fair young man and a studious youth (p. 204), but on Arcana Diary the Page can be anyone, of any age or gender, who meets life with curiosity and a soft heart. It can also stand for a message or a mood rather than a person.

waite.quote: Fair young man, one impelled to render service … a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation … Reversed: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

citations.text: contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him. It is the pictures of the mind taking form.
The implicit is that the Sign of the Cup naturally refers to water, which appears in all the court cards.

Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.
Reversed: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.
Graceful, but not warlike; riding quietly, wearing a winged helmet
Arrival, approach—sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanour, invitation, incitement.
